title: Decision: INSERT OR REPLACE with sub-select to preserve first_seen_at
description: contact.rs lines 31-35 use INSERT OR REPLACE with a sub-select to preserve first_seen_at when a contact is updated: the INSERT references first_seen_at = ?5 (now_unix) for new rows, but the ON CONFLICT clause does NOT update first_seen_at. This records when a peer was first seen while allowing their login, host, and display_name to evolve. Rejected alternative: separate INSERT/UPDATE logic would be error-prone across the upsert boundary.
